entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.
And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Kanaujia

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.52 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5(J)(II)/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Pali District Hardoi.
3. In terms of the FIR, a missing person report was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.

Subsequently in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that both of them had married and the victim was carrying a fetus of one month, the tentative age of the victim is around 19 years.

entities.text: Dinesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the applicant who is in custody since 05.03.2024 and has no criminal history is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Dinesh be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 VNP/-
